$comment: Acceptance criteria for GATE-1 (onboarding simulation, spec 57-60).

amendments.reason: Original criterion required file_exists conformance/fixtures/onboarding-a-greenfield, assuming fixtures would be committed trees. Committing them let the parent repository's git remote resolve inside fixture A and produce a false github-projects roadmap candidate, which §58 forbids ('no providers silently assigned'). Fixtures became declarative specs materialized into isolated temp repos. The criterion described an implementation that was wrong, not a bar that was too high.
